## Safety checklist

- [ ] The change is game-local and reversible.
- [ ] Unknown executable builds fail closed.
- [ ] No proprietary executable, backup, trace, archive, injector, trainer, or bypass is included.
- [ ] Anti-cheat and online-use boundaries are documented accurately.
- [ ] `./tools/Validate-Repository.ps1` passes.
- [ ] The relevant release builder produces a verified ZIP.
